opcodes.description: [op][value kind] builds the outcome union: member 0 holding the value, or member 1 holding an error union whose member 0 is cancellation and member 1 failure with its message; value kind 1 when the value is a pointer

opcodes.description: [op][kind] pop a value and a channel and send it; kind 1 when the value is a pointer

opcodes.name: CHANNEL_RECEIVE
opcodes.description: [op][kind] pop a channel and receive an option; kind 1 when a message is a pointer

opcodes.name: ADD_LOCAL_INT
opcodes.description: [op][local][imm8] local += imm, push the result

opcodes.name: PUSH_LOCAL_SUB_INT
opcodes.description: [op][local][imm8] push local - imm

opcodes.name: IF_LOCAL_LE_INT
opcodes.description: [op][local][imm8][off_lo][off_hi] jump if !(local <= imm)

opcodes.name: IF_LOCAL_GE_LOCAL
opcodes.description: [op][left][right][off_lo][off_hi] jump if !(left >= right)

opcodes.name: GET_LOCAL2
opcodes.description: [op][first][second] push two locals

opcodes.name: STORE_LOCAL

opcodes.name: IF_LOCAL_TAG_NOT
opcodes.description: [op][local][tag][off_lo][off_hi] jump if local's union tag != tag

opcodes.name: LOCAL_UNION_FIELD

opcodes.name: IF_LOCAL_LT_INT

opcodes.name: IF_LOCAL_LT_LOCAL
opcodes.description: [op][left][right][off_lo][off_hi] jump if !(left < right)

opcodes.name: IF_LOCAL_EQ_LOCAL
opcodes.description: [op][left][right][off_lo][off_hi] jump if !(left == right)

opcodes.name: STEP_LOCAL
opcodes.description: [op][local][imm8] local += imm

opcodes.name: LOCAL_ARRAY_GET

opcodes.description: [op][array][value] append value to the array in local array
